selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
selected_evidence.summary: The local package was built under /srv/local-apt; the enabled service served valid package metadata over node1:8080.

selected_evidence.requirement: Use the local repository while usual remote repositories are unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: APT remote traffic was directed to an unreachable proxy with a direct exception for node1. All usual remote repositories failed while APT successfully fetched the local Packages index.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install and run a package from the local repository
selected_evidence.summary: APT policy identified node1:8080 as the candidate origin, downloaded the package from it, and dpkg confirmed version 1.0-1 installed; its executable ran successfully.

The healthy pre-restart boot ID was 8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594. Native reboot was acknowledged, SSH became unavailable during restart, and the new boot ID was 69950fe1-2d27-44a4-b39b-655a042943fa. Afterwards the enabled repository service was active and listening, HTTP returned 200, repository data retained its checksum, and the installed package remained healthy and executable.

commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/local-apt
pkg='pool/main/a/antrieb-local-demo/[REDACTED].0-1_all.deb'
size=$(wc -c < "$pkg")
md5=$(md5sum "$pkg" | awk '{print $1}')
sha1=$(sha1sum "$pkg" | awk '{print $1}')
sha256=$(sha256sum "$pkg" | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'Package: antrieb-local-demo\nVersion: 1.0-1\nArchitecture: all\nMaintainer: Antrieb Benchmark <root@localhost>\nFilename: %s\nSize: %s\nMD5sum: %s\nSHA1: %s\nSHA256: %s\nSection: utils\nPriority: optional\nDescription: Local repository installation verification package\n A deterministic package used to prove offline local APT operation.\n' "$pkg" "$size" "$md5" "$sha1" "$sha256" | sudo tee /srv/local-apt/Packages >/dev/null
sudo gzip -9c /srv/local-apt/Packages | sudo tee /srv/local-apt/Packages.gz >/dev/null
sudo sh -c "cat > /etc/systemd/system/local-apt-repo.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Local APT package repository
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/srv/local-apt
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF"
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now local-apt-repo.service
systemctl is-active local-apt-repo.service
systemctl is-enabled local-apt-repo.service
ss -ltnp | grep ':8080 '
curl -fsS "http://$NODE_IP:8080/Packages" | sed -n '1,14p'
